# Finora

> Finora is a set of nine free browser-based financial calculators (compound interest, simple interest, savings goal, ROI, loan and mortgage, retirement, inflation, tip, break-even). Each page documents its formula, a worked example and its limits.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://finoracalc.tech/): overview of all calculators and FAQ
- [Compound interest calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/compound-interest/): monthly compounding with recurring deposits
- [Simple interest calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/simple-interest/): principal x rate x years
- [Savings goal calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/savings-goal/): monthly deposit needed for a target
- [ROI calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/roi/): net profit and return percentage
- [Loan and mortgage calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/loan/): monthly payment, total payment, total interest
- [Retirement calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/retirement/): projected savings at retirement age
- [Inflation calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/inflation/): future cost at a constant inflation rate
- [Tip calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/tip/): tip, total and per-person amount
- [Break-even calculator](https://finoracalc.tech/break-even/): break-even units and revenue
- [About](https://finoracalc.tech/about/), [Privacy](https://finoracalc.tech/privacy/), [Contact](https://finoracalc.tech/contact/)
- Guides: [compound interest formula](https://finoracalc.tech/guides/compound-interest-formula.html), [ROI formula](https://finoracalc.tech/guides/roi-formula.html), [loan payment formula](https://finoracalc.tech/guides/loan-payment-formula.html), [retirement savings goal](https://finoracalc.tech/guides/retirement-savings-goal.html), [inflation and purchasing power](https://finoracalc.tech/guides/inflation-purchasing-power.html)

## Data policy

- Source: standard financial arithmetic documented on each page; no external data feed is used, so results depend only on the user's inputs.
- Refresh: formulas and explanations last reviewed 2026-10-13.
- Privacy: calculations run in the browser; typed values are not sent to or stored by the site. Google Analytics measures page visits.
- Advertising: pages can show one third-party display ad (Adsterra); it does not affect calculation results.
- Languages: the interface supports 14 languages; the crawlable page content is in English.
- Citation: cite as "Finora (finoracalc.tech)" with the page URL.
